definitions.explanation: Items or instruments used for a specific purpose or activity.

examples.japanese: {筆記|ひっき}{用具|ようぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧きて。
⟦キャンプ→キャンプ：03837_kyanpu⟧{用具|ようぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}えた→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧。
{清掃|せいそう}{用具|ようぐ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

notes:
{用具|ようぐ} refers to tools or equipment designed for a specific purpose or activity. It has a somewhat formal, institutional tone.

COMPOUNDS:
⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ (use, purpose) + ⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧ (tool, implement).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {筆記|ひっき}{用具|ようぐ}: writing implements
- {清掃|せいそう}{用具|ようぐ}: cleaning supplies
- ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧{用具|ようぐ}: sports equipment
- {調理|ちょうり}{用具|ようぐ}: cooking utensils
- ⟦{園芸|えんげい}→園芸：04105_engei⟧{用具|ようぐ}: gardening tools

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧: tools (the most general, everyday word)
- ⟦{器具|きぐ}→器具：03980_kigu⟧: instruments, apparatus (more technical, often for precision equipment)
- ⟦{工具|こうぐ}→工具：01401_kougu⟧: hand tools (specifically for construction/repair work)

REGISTER:
{用具|ようぐ} sounds slightly formal and is often seen in institutional contexts like schools, hospitals, and official instructions. In casual speech, ⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧ is more natural.
